stemMd: Which finding would most strengthen the residents' causal concern?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Residents discussed the issue more often.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Comparable regularly inspected racks showed increased new damage after brighter lighting, while similar unchanged racks did not.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The council made its complaint form easier to find.

options.label: E
options.textMd: More old damage became visible at night.

explanationMd: A comparison of new damage under consistent inspection with unchanged sites addresses detection and background trends. It would strengthen, though not make infallible, the claim that lighting affected actual damage.

distractorRationale.a: Energy efficiency does not measure vandalism.
distractorRationale.b: Discussion can increase reports without more damage.
distractorRationale.e: This supports detection rather than new vandalism.
distractorRationale.d: This is an alternative reporting explanation.
